justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDateFormat.java (636 LOC, 43 method declarations) plus the collaborator classes src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinter.java and src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDateParser.java. FastDateFormat is mostly a thin facade: its formatting methods delegate to printer, its parsing methods delegate to parser, and the class mainly provides factory/cache access and value-object methods (equals/hashCode/toString). The substantive formatting/parsing logic is split into the two sibling classes, so this class does not show clear insufficient modularization.
